description.en: Michigan is a peninsular state in the Great Lakes and Upper Midwest regions of the United States. It shares water and land boundaries with Minnesota to the northwest, Wisconsin to the west, Indiana and Illinois to the southwest, Ohio to the southeast, and the Canadian province of Ontario to the east, northeast and north.
description.zh-CN: 密西根州，簡稱密州，是美国的一个州，位於五大湖地區，東面與加拿大首都渥太华的所在地安大略省接壤。其邮政缩写是 MI。
description.zh-TW: 密西根州，簡稱密州，是美國的一個州，位於五大湖地區，東面與加拿大首都渥太華的所在地安大略省接壤。其郵政縮寫是 MI。
